what_this_is: The constants B5a's F2 estimates read for extension fields (design/extension-fields.md §2.6). Each names its source. They are models' inputs, not measurements of any run; B5a's measurement 6 replaces the provisional ones.

extension.status: provisional: the one-word prime field's step cost (../B2-fields-forms-estimates/estimates.json, rho-negation.prime), until measurement 6
provisional: the prime field's step cost at width 127 (../B2-fields-forms-estimates/estimates.json, rho-bignum.prime), until measurement 6

ic-gaudry-cubic.source: research/notes/index-calculus/RESEARCH_RESIDUAL_WALKS.md §11.2: the meet-in-the-middle rows, total operations proportional to n^0.69 over p = 271 to 2083, at the largest rung
ic-gaudry-cubic.status: provisional: the note's own host and wall time, until measurement 6 re-anchors it on the reference host and refits the exponent over G1-G3
ic-gaudry-cubic.variant: the module's GaudryOptions::default(): the meet-in-the-middle oracle, dense elimination, no large primes
